cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's closed. Wait at the till until I dismiss you; I'll finish the evening properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll do your dismissal by the door. You can stand with her; I want this comfortable for everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our taxi's here. I'm putting her in it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll walk as far as you want me to. Once she's settled, look back and I'll give you the nod to leave. You choose the pace; I still need to release you.

reason: Keep the dismissal privilege explicit while A negotiates distance and timing around the family departure, without assuming entry into B taxi.
